method: candidate lines proposed by corridor detection; identity decided from printed address runs and street-name labels
why_not_one_block_off: Both sheets print 'AVENUE Q' at the seam, 80' wide. Sheet 53 (west) shows its east block face with Ave-Q frontages 2502 2504 ... 2528 (25th-26th block) and 25th-St runs ending '2013 2015 2017 2019 2021 2023 / 2014 2016 ... 2024' (2000 hundred-block, i.e. Ave P 1/2-Q). Sheet 54 (east) shows the opposite face with frontages 2501 2503 ... 2527 and 25th-St runs starting '2101 2103 ... 2111 / 2102 2104 ... 2112' then '2113 ... 2123' at Ave Q 1/2. The 2000/2100 change on 25th St happens across this avenue, so it is Q and not P 1/2 or Q 1/2 (Q 1/2 is separately labelled on sheet 54 one block east).
